title: DynamicFields editor vocabulary
description: Annotations for editors: value groups, the dialog that edits a field, and whether (and where) a post can be made of it.

group.description: The key of the group a value is in.

groups.description: A root field's value groups, in order; the first is the default.

editorDialog.description: Another module's dialog that edits this field instead of the generic editor.

canBeRoot.description: Whether a post can be made of this field.

urlPrefix.description: A root field's public route prefix: news, ar/news.
